a1
After Shechem, God told Jacob: go up to Bethel, and build an altar there.
a2
Jacob told his household: put away the foreign gods, and change your clothes. They gave them up, and he buried them under an oak.
b1
As they traveled, a terror from God fell on the towns around them, and no one pursued.
b2
At Bethel Jacob built an altar. God appeared to him again, blessed him, and said: your name is Israel.
c1
They traveled on. Near Ephrath, Rachel went into hard labor. The midwife said: do not fear, you have another son.
c2
Rachel died. She had named the boy Ben-oni, son of my sorrow, but Jacob named him Benjamin.
d1
He buried her on the road to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem, and set up a pillar over her grave.
e1
Jacob came home to Isaac, who died at a great age. Esau and Jacob buried him.
h1
Before returning to Bethel, Jacob's household put away their other gods.
h2
Jacob said God had been with him wherever he went.
h3
Let go of what you hold in God's place, and return to where you first met him.
h4
Today, name one thing to put down.
i
What do you need to let go of?
